title: Integrated Feature Selection for classification and Representation Learning with Group-Lasso Siamese Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.39499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (Lasso) has been widely employed for feature selection in linear models and has also been extended to multi-layer perceptron (MLP) networks for both feature and group feature selection. Group-Lasso has also been used in feature selection using feed-forward neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to incorporate the Group-Lasso principle into a Siamese network architecture for feature selection. Unlike existing approaches that primarily optimize classification accuracy, the proposed method aims to identify a compact subset of features that simultaneously preserves the intrinsic representation of the input data (the goal of Siamese network) and is expected to achieve high classification performance. translated_title: 基于Group-Lasso孪生网络的分类与表示学习一体化特征选择
translated_abstract: 最小绝对收缩与选择算子已被广泛应用于线性模型中的特征选择，并已被扩展到多层感知机（MLP）网络中用于特征选择和组特征选择。Group-Lasso 也已被用于前馈神经网络的特征选择。据我们所知，这是首次将 Group-Lasso 原理融入孪生网络架构进行特征选择的研究。与现有主要优化分类准确率的方法不同，所提出的方法旨在识别一个紧凑的特征子集，该子集既能保留输入数据的内在表示（即孪生网络的目标），又有望实现较高的分类性能。该框架开发了两个变体：一个基于欧氏距离，另一个基于针对实值向量改进的 Jaccard 相似度度量。
tldr: 本工作首次将Group-Lasso原理引入孪生网络架构，实现了同时保留数据内在表示并保证高分类性能的一体化紧凑特征选择。
en_tdlr: This is the first study to incorporate the Group-Lasso principle into a Siamese network architecture, enabling integrated feature selection that simultaneously preserves the intrinsic representation of input data and achieves high classification performance.
